_readme: Pinned lint/type baseline, gated by tools.health SUITE-04. It exists because OG-02's error count drifted across three different values in three documents over two phases, with nothing measuring it — and because this session's own edits silently took ruff from 22 to 26 before a manual measurement caught it. A number nobody compares is decoration.
_mypy_note: The 22 remaining mypy --strict errors are annotation debt with no behavioural consequence: missing generic parameters on `dict`, `Returning Any` from json.loads boundaries, and one absent third-party stub (weasyprint, an optional PDF-only dependency). The classes that COULD bite were fixed 2026-08-20: `Path / None` in engine_config (7 errors, a real TypeError at import time on a config with a null value) and three in tools/health/checks.py. This ceiling may only go DOWN; SUITE-04 fails if a run exceeds it. Lowered 23 -> 22 on 2026-08-21 when the counter-example suite landed and a stale `type: ignore` went with it.
_ruff_note: Zero is the pin, not a baseline to live with. Reached 2026-08-20 by fixing two real bugs (an undefined `RoutedEdge` annotation, two ambiguous implicit string concatenations inside list literals) plus safe autofixes.
